breaking.change: The engine ships no .svelte documents: every built-in component and screen is a TSX component only, so `og.load.document(world, "@ui/<path>.svelte")` and a `.svelte` page that uses a built-in component by name find nothing, and `og ui eject` has nothing to copy.
breaking.fix: Import the component from `@origingame/engine/ui/components` (or `@origingame/engine/ui/screens/<name>.tsx`) and mount it with `mount(world, () => Component(props), {}, { layer })` from `@origingame/engine/ui`, as a game's own TSX HUD does; a store's value reaches it through `useStore`.
